code = "python3 - <<'PY'
g=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for c in range(3,12): g[2][c]=g[10][c]=3
for r in range(2,11): g[r][3]=g[r][11]=3
for r in range(3,10):
 for c in range(4,11):
  d=max(abs(r-5),abs(c-4))
  g[r][c]=3 if d==0 else (4 if d%2 else 2)
for row in g: print(row)
PY"
print(terminal(code))
